# `percentile_cont`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Return a percentile value based on a continuous distribution of numeric or ANSI interval column `col` at the given `percentage` (specified in ORDER BY clause).

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
percentile_cont(percentage) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY col)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- percentile_cont, example 1
> SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY col) FROM VALUES (0), (10) AS tab(col);
2.5
```

```sql
-- percentile_cont, example 2
> SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY col) FROM VALUES (INTERVAL '0' MONTH), (INTERVAL '10' MONTH) AS tab(col);
0-2
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
